note: Both sets mix sound text-derived values (KP(0°)=0.01882681 s, KD=0.0 s², ζφ=0.7) with chart readings, and both repeat the same misread 0.018182881 s and the same left-axis misbindings (e.g. Proportional Gain 0.8 s at 0°, 0.18 s at 20°). Set A additionally captures the GK(θ)=1/(1+θ/θK) law and the gain-scheduled PI controller type, plus several correct right-axis chart points (KP≈0.010 s at 5°, ≈0.004 s at 23°, KI≈0.004 at 5°), which Set B omits. Set B is padded with near-duplicate claims (gain-correction factor 1.0 at 0° and ζφ=0.7 each repeated three times) and adds its own misbindings (integral gain 0.32 at 0°, gain-correction factor 0.015 at 5°), so although it has fewer outright wrong claims, it carries less correct, non-redundant content and misses the gain-scheduling formula.
